address: 441 Zhuangjing Road, Xinyi District, Taipei, Taiwan
bio: Living up to its name, Open Smile delivers simple pleasure through food. The bright, stylish setting lends an air of relaxation. With braised dishes at its core, the menu highlights Taiwanese-style braised pork, glazed pork belly and deep-fried braised ribs. The pork, slowly braised, is tender with a gentle chew and a balanced sweetness, and goes well with both rice and noodles. Beyond pork, options like chicken with scallion sauce or Sichuan peppercorn oil provide additional variety. For an extra kick, try the house-made chilli sauce.
